checks.describe: the client sets an explicit timeout policy instead of relying on a library default
checks.run: grep -c 'DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = httpx.Timeout' labs/checkpoints/v0.7/src/platformops/httpclient.py

checks.describe: a token passed for authentication never appears in a log line -- only the fact that one was supplied does
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.7 && uv run python3 -c "import logging,io; from platformops.httpclient import _auth_headers; buf=io.StringIO(); h=logging.StreamHandler(buf); logging.getLogger('platformops.httpclient').addHandler(h); logging.getLogger('platformops.httpclient').setLevel(logging.DEBUG); _auth_headers('super-secret-token-value'); text=buf.getvalue(); print('leaked' if 'super-secret-token-value' in text else 'not-leaked')"

checks.describe: http-check against a reachable, healthy endpoint exits 0 -- example.com, not the GitHub API, so this check never flakes on the anonymous rate limit the other checks below already spend
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.7 && uv run platformops http-check https://example.com > /dev/null 2>&1; echo $?

checks.describe: http-check on a URL missing a scheme is a usage error, exit 2, caught before any network call
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.7 && uv run platformops http-check not-a-url > /dev/null 2>&1; echo $?

checks.describe: http-check against a host that cannot be reached at all still exits 1, distinct from the exit-2 usage error above
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.7 && uv run platformops http-check https://this-host-does-not-exist-platformops-lab.example --timeout 5 > /dev/null 2>&1; echo $?

checks.describe: repo-info --json on a real public repository prints a parseable object with status ok
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.7 && uv run platformops repo-info octocat/Hello-World --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d['status'])"

checks.describe: repo-info against a repository that does not exist reports the 404 and exits 1
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.7 && uv run platformops repo-info octocat/this-repo-does-not-exist-at-all-xyz > /dev/null 2>&1; echo $?

checks.describe: repo-info given a slug with no owner/repo slash is a usage error, exit 2
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.7 && uv run platformops repo-info not-a-slug > /dev/null 2>&1; echo $?

checks.describe: workflow-runs against a repository with a long CI history collects more results than a single GitHub page (30) holds -- proof the Link-header pagination actually followed a next page
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.7 && uv run platformops workflow-runs kubernetes-sigs/kind --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('multi-page' if d['count'] > 30 else 'single-page')"

checks.describe: --max-pages 1 caps workflow-runs at one page's worth of results, even against a repository with far more history available
checks.run: cd labs/checkpoints/v0.7 && uv run platformops workflow-runs kubernetes-sigs/kind --max-pages 1 --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('capped' if d['count'] <= 30 else 'not-capped')"

checks.describe: _request_with_retry is only ever invoked with GET in httpclient.py, matching the idempotent-retry-only design
checks.run: grep -n '_request_with_retry(client,' labs/checkpoints/v0.7/src/platformops/httpclient.py
